mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_session_round_trace ( session_id, user_id, agent_id, turn_number, current_intent, enhancement_cache_hit, enhancement_cache_reason, raw_user_message, assistant_message, tool_summary, success, error_message, total_steps, created_at ) VALUES ( #{sessionId}, #{userId}, #{agentId}, #{turnNumber}, #{currentIntent}, #{enhancementCacheHit}, #{enhancementCacheReason}, #{rawUserMessage}, #{assistantMessage}, #{toolSummary}, #{success}, #{errorMessage}, #{totalSteps}, now() )
mapper.select: SELECT id, session_id, user_id, agent_id, turn_number, current_intent, enhancement_cache_hit, enhancement_cache_reason, raw_user_message, assistant_message, tool_summary, success, error_message, total_steps, created_at FROM chat_session_round_trace WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
